pricing.title: Start free. Scale when ready.
pricing.payment_note: Payments secured by Lemon Squeezy · Cancel anytime
pricing.a1: Each time you click the Permacite icon on a page, that is one archive. The same URL archived twice counts twice.
pricing.q2: What happens when I reach the free limit?
pricing.a2: Permacite shows an upgrade prompt. Your existing archives and citations remain accessible.
pricing.q3: Can I cancel my Pro subscription?
pricing.a3: Yes, at any time from your Lemon Squeezy billing portal. Your account reverts to the Free plan.
pricing.a4: APA 7th edition and MLA 9th edition are both generated automatically.
